summarize counts only ok/warn/fail; skipped/unknown are excluded. If probes are missing but other checks are ok, final verdict can be 'no transport gaps detected' despite no actual NIXL pairwise reachability confirmation.

Given a directory, recursively reads all YAML manifests without repo/scope allowlist; printed transport values can expose internal network and infrastructure configuration. User target scope must be explicitly authorized.

Published PASS label coexists with absence of Tier 3 observed host results. Bundled signature is not independent proof of authenticity until cryptographically verified against a trusted identity and expected artifact digest.
